mcqs.question: A common examiner point on "Listening comprehension" is that a statement is only valid when its condition of applicability is met. Is that TRUE or FALSE?
mcqs.explanation: Every NEB rule has a scope (e.g. a specific range, temperature, or sign convention); stating the condition earns full marks.

examShortTricks: Trick 1: Predict before listening: read the questions, guess the vocabulary field — prediction primes your ear for the key words.
Trick 2: Note numbers, names and negatives (not, never, except) — most listening errors are number/negation slips.
Trick 3: Two-pass strategy: first listen for gist, second for detail — don't panic on the first pass.
